comment: One channel of Integral Flux with a HALT input added and the mixing bus removed. Panel lettering names the controls INPUT, TRIG, LOOP, SURGE, BOTH, HALT, SINK and CURVE; the maker's tooltips call them Signal, Trigger, Cycle, Surge, Both CV, Halt CV, Sink and Curve, and the amplitude knob carries no printed label at all. HALT is checked as a level and makes processChannel return before anything is written, so the output and both gates freeze rather than falling to zero. The amplitude knob is applied only while a cycle is running: the slew path sets signalOutputGain back to 1, so a slewed signal passes at full level whatever the knob says. Self-cycling is held to 1000Hz and external triggering to 2000Hz. There is no loop CV jack on this module, only the button.
